fields.label: Check Moves
fields.description: Before a Kanban drag, run the save checks without saving and show what blocks the move.

fields.label: Show Flow
fields.description: The Flow (every stage and its steps): a Flow button on the form and the card menu, and on a blocked move. Off: none of them, and a blocked move shows only its message with its buttons. Fields a rule asks for are asked in a popup either way.

fields.label: Flow Steps Method
fields.description: Optional. A method that returns the steps of each stage for the Flow: a whitelisted Python method or an API Server Script. It receives doctype and name and returns {"steps": [{"stage", "label", "done", "action", "action_label", "waiting_on"}]} (a Server Script sets frappe.flags.result).
